answer: Mutual vouching with decaying vouch budgets: each agent gets 3 vouches per epoch, each staking 10 tokens, and a vouch's weight halves every 30 days unless renewed. If agent violet vouches for ivory and ivory is flagged as a sybil, violet is slashed. To seat 1000 sybils on one jetty host, an attacker must drain 334 real budgets and risk 10,000 tokens. Decay stops old vouches from being stockpiled.
